why: The article and thesis do not state 15 March 2027 as a publication date, so its basis is not stated.
The Neutral condition does not name a baseline against which the open review is neutral.
The middle range of 0.3% to below 0.32% excludes the 31% guidance, the ranges use the wrong percentage scale and are not a fair division around it, and the reference records 0.31 instead of 31.
The fiscal year ending in January does not explain why higher revenue is favourable.
The rungs use a target that management has not yet confirmed instead of the stated 5 million sign-ups, and the reference omits that number.
The wording asserts that revenue will exceed guidance instead of asking what revenue will be reported.
No report of 5 million sign-ups does not establish that the scheme failed to reach 5 million, and the reference omits that number.
The Neutral condition does not say that it is assessed against the expected clearance with store sales.
